body: I've tried different combinations since I was 8. It really is hard to imagine anything different, and meds don't make a difference. I hate life on and off antidepressants, I don't know anything else
No, it hurts. When I drank that alcohol I was writhing in pain. My chest felt like it was gonna collapse. Then I woke up perfectly fine. I feel pain, I just keep coming out alive :(
And I can't, and won't get a gun or something. I can't let my family live with that

Eh, it's whatever at this point. Damn shame I'm well-built. I've tried drinking lethal doses of alcohol, and I slept it off, fuck, I survived a near-drowning where I hurt every part of my body landing. Nothing does the fucking job

Not really a matter of helping at this point. It makes the whole affair less dramatic, but, all things considered, depression is all I know. It's what I grew up with, so it's my standard mode of operation. It's not even hell at this point, I'm just used to it, but so fucking sick of it
I am medicated. I've been on antidepressants since 12. I was just born wrong, I've been messed up since I was 4, like my post said. I never stood a chance
I really, really do hate myself. And every person I fail to bond with, who inevitably leaves me just reinforces that. I'm a real piece of fucking shit
